self.scope: how the league chat sees Nick

P-Alpha.name: Typical reply time
P-Alpha.measured_by: the median gap between a message from someone else and his next message in the same thread, counting only gaps under 6 hours
P-Alpha.withheld: only 0 observations; a variable needs 5 to be reported

P-Alpha.name: Slow reply time
P-Alpha.measured_by: the ninetieth percentile of the same gaps: how long a reply takes on his slow days
P-Alpha.withheld: only 0 observations; a variable needs 5 to be reported

P-Alpha.name: Reply time, later vs earlier
P-Alpha.measured_by: his median reply time over the later half of his messages divided by the earlier half; above 1 means he is getting slower
P-Alpha.withheld: only 0 observations; a variable needs 5 to be reported

P-Alpha.name: Replies to Nick vs to everyone else
P-Alpha.measured_by: his median reply time to Nick divided by his median reply time to anyone else; below 1 means Nick gets answered first
P-Alpha.withheld: only 0 observations; a variable needs 5 to be reported

P-Alpha.name: How often he starts it
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages sent after at least 3 hours of silence in that thread

P-Alpha.name: How often he has the last word
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages followed by at least 6 hours of silence

P-Alpha.name: Messages per active hour
P-Alpha.measured_by: his message count divided by the number of distinct hours he sent anything in: how much he arrives in bursts

P-Alpha.name: How much he talks during games
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages sent on a Sunday between 1pm and 7pm Eastern, when games are on

P-Alpha.name: Message length
P-Alpha.measured_by: the mean character count of his messages

P-Alpha.name: Typical message length
P-Alpha.measured_by: the median character count, which a few essays cannot drag

P-Alpha.name: How often he writes at length
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages longer than 200 characters

P-Alpha.name: How often he asks
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages containing a question mark

P-Alpha.name: Emoji
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages containing an emoji

P-Alpha.name: Shouting
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages written entirely in capitals

P-Alpha.name: Hedging
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages containing one of 20 hedging phrases (lexicons.js)

P-Alpha.name: Superlatives
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages containing one of 20 intensity words (lexicons.js); a person whose baseline is superlative gives no signal by using one

P-Alpha.name: Negation
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages containing a negation

P-Alpha.name: Talks about himself vs about you
P-Alpha.measured_by: his I/me/my word count divided by his you/your word count
P-Alpha.withheld: measured on 8 observations and undefined for him — the quantity has no value here, which is not the same as being zero

P-Alpha.name: Flat refusals
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages containing a refusal that closes the subject (lexicons.js)

P-Alpha.name: Refusals that leave the door open
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages containing a deferral rather than a refusal (lexicons.js); telling these two apart is the point of having both

P-Alpha.name: How much of it is not fantasy
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages the classifier labelled non-fantasy (jev_chat_signals topic.non_fantasy); high here means a person profile built from his chat is mostly not about football

P-Alpha.name: How much of it is player opinions
P-Alpha.measured_by: the share of his messages the classifier labelled as an opinion about a player

P-Alpha.name: How much his confidence swings
P-Alpha.measured_by: the standard deviation of the per-message confidence the classifier assigned him; manager_chat_profile keeps only the mean, which is exactly what hides a reactive person
P-Alpha.withheld: only 0 observations; a variable needs 5 to be reported

P-Alpha.name: How much he talks at night
P-Alpha.measured_by: read from manager_chat_profile, which the chat extractor writes
